candidates.change_summary: Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender, bypassing withdraw(), which changes routing and thus observable behavior if withdraw() were overridden or altered.

Remove the onlyOwner modifier requirement by making the function public without owner restriction (effect achieved by removing modifier invocation), allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and thus changing observable behavior of who can withdraw.
Invert the owner check in onlyOwner so it requires msg.sender != owner, changing which callers are allowed and therefore altering withdrawAll's observable effect.
Replace transfer to send to the owner variable instead of msg.sender, so withdraw sends funds to owner rather than the caller.
Replace transfer to send zero value regardless of _value, so withdraw always sends 0 and does not transfer requested amount.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner (invert check), making withdraw callable only by non-owners and thus changing who receives funds.
